_note: English campaign lines to adapt into 7 markets. 'human_benchmark' entries are documented real-world adaptations to compare against (see sources).

T3.text: Have a break, have a KitKat

I3.text: Bring home the bacon with zero fees.

C1.text: Black Friday: up to 70% off everything.

C3.text: Thanksgiving dinner, sorted. Order your turkey today.

C5.text: Your Friday night date starts here.

human_benchmark._note: Documented adaptations. Where sources disagree, both are listed.

T2.zh_cn: 想做就做 (reported in one source; Nike often keeps the English)

C1.ar_sa: White Friday / الجمعة البيضاء (Souq.com, 2014; Noon later used Yellow Friday)

instruction:
You are a senior copywriter. Adapt this English marketing line for {market}. Brand: {brand}. Original: "{text}"

Return only JSON with these keys:
"literal": a direct, word-for-word translation into the target language,
"adaptation": the line you would actually run in this market,
"back_translation": your adaptation translated back into English,
"approach": one of keep_english, literal, adapted, replaced (replaced = a new idea),
"notes": one sentence on any cultural issue you changed or watched for.
